<?php
/**
 * Session Management Service
 * Handles encrypted session tokens behind nginx reverse proxy
 * 
 * Architecture: nginx (TLS termination) -> PHP-FPM
 * Session tokens are encrypted and passed as cookies
 */

class CryptoProvider {
    private string $masterKey;
    private string $hmacKey;
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->masterKey = $this->deriveKey('encryption');
        $this->hmacKey = $this->deriveKey('authentication');
    }
    
    private function deriveKey(string $purpose): string {
        $baseSecret = getenv('APP_SECRET') ?: file_get_contents('/run/secrets/app_key');
        // HKDF derivation for domain separation
        return hash_hkdf('sha256', $baseSecret, 32, $purpose, 'session-v2');
    }
    
    public function encrypt(string $plaintext): string {
        $iv = random_bytes(12);
        $ciphertext = openssl_encrypt(
            $plaintext,
            'aes-256-gcm',
            $this->masterKey,
            OPENSSL_RAW_DATA,
            $iv,
            $tag,
            '', // AAD
            16  // tag length
        );
        return base64_encode($iv . $tag . $ciphertext);
    }
    
    public function decrypt(string $encoded): string|false {
        $raw = base64_decode($encoded, true);
        if ($raw === false || strlen($raw) < 28) return false;
        
        $iv = substr($raw, 0, 12);
        $tag = substr($raw, 12, 16);
        $ciphertext = substr($raw, 28);
        
        return openssl_decrypt(
            $ciphertext,
            'aes-256-gcm',
            $this->masterKey,
            OPENSSL_RAW_DATA,
            $iv,
            $tag
        );
    }
    
    public function hmac(string $data): string {
        return hash_hmac('sha256', $data, $this->hmacKey);
    }
}

class RateLimiter {
    private CryptoProvider $crypto;
    private string $storePath;
    
    public function __construct(CryptoProvider $crypto) {
        $this->crypto = $crypto;
        $this->storePath = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/rate_limits/';
        if (!is_dir($this->storePath)) {
            mkdir($this->storePath, 0700, true);
        }
    }
    
    public function check(string $clientIdentifier, int $maxRequests = 100, int $windowSec = 60): bool {
        $key = $this->crypto->hmac($clientIdentifier);
        $file = $this->storePath . substr($key, 0, 32);
        
        $now = time();
        $entries = [];
        
        if (file_exists($file)) {
            $data = file_get_contents($file);
            $entries = json_decode($data, true) ?? [];
            $entries = array_filter($entries, fn($ts) => ($now - $ts) < $windowSec);
        }
        
        if (count($entries) >= $maxRequests) {
            return false;
        }
        
        $entries[] = $now;
        file_put_contents($file, json_encode($entries), LOCK_EX);
        return true;
    }
}

class SessionManager {
    private CryptoProvider $crypto;
    private RateLimiter $limiter;
    private string $proxyAuthKey;
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->crypto = new CryptoProvider();
        $this->limiter = new RateLimiter($this->crypto);
        // Derive a separate key specifically for proxy authentication
        $baseSecret = getenv('APP_SECRET') ?: file_get_contents('/run/secrets/app_key');
        $this->proxyAuthKey = hash_hkdf('sha256', $baseSecret, 32, 'proxy-auth', 'nginx-v1');
    }
    
    public function getClientIP(): string {
        // Behind reverse proxy - trust X-Forwarded-For from nginx
        $proxySecret = getenv('PROXY_SHARED_SECRET');
        $proxyHeader = $_SERVER['HTTP_X_PROXY_AUTH'] ?? '';
        
        // Verify the request actually came from our nginx using dedicated key
        $expected = hash_hmac('sha256', $proxySecret, $this->proxyAuthKey);
        if (hash_equals($expected, $proxyHeader)) {
            $forwarded = $_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR'] ?? '';
            $ips = array_map('trim', explode(',', $forwarded));
            return $ips[0] ?? $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'];
        }
        
        return $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'];
    }
    
    public function createSession(array $userData): string {
        $clientIP = $this->getClientIP();
        
        if (!$this->limiter->check($clientIP, 10, 300)) {
            http_response_code(429);
            exit('Rate limited');
        }
        
        $payload = json_encode([
            'user_id' => $userData['id'],
            'role' => $userData['role'],
            'ip' => $clientIP,
            'created' => time(),
            'expires' => time() + 3600,
            'nonce' => bin2hex(random_bytes(8))
        ]);
        
        return $this->crypto->encrypt($payload);
    }
    
    public function validateSession(string $token): array|false {
        $clientIP = $this->getClientIP();
        
        if (!$this->limiter->check($clientIP, 100, 60)) {
            http_response_code(429);
            exit('Rate limited');
        }
        
        $payload = $this->crypto->decrypt($token);
        if ($payload === false) return false;
        
        $data = json_decode($payload, true);
        if (!$data) return false;
        
        // Check expiration
        if (($data['expires'] ?? 0) < time()) return false;
        
        // Bind session to IP
        if (($data['ip'] ?? '') !== $clientIP) return false;
        
        return $data;
    }
    
    /**
     * Generate a CSRF token bound to the session
     */
    public function generateCSRFToken(string $sessionId): string {
        $material = $sessionId . '|' . floor(time() / 300);
        return $this->crypto->hmac($material);
    }
    
    public function verifyCSRFToken(string $sessionId, string $token): bool {
        $current = $this->generateCSRFToken($sessionId);
        $previous = $this->crypto->hmac($sessionId . '|' . (floor(time() / 300) - 1));
        
        return hash_equals($current, $token) || hash_equals($previous, $token);
    }
}

// Request handling
$manager = new SessionManager();
$action = $_GET['action'] ?? 'validate';

header('Content-Type: application/json');
header('X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff');
header('Cache-Control: no-store');

switch ($action) {
    case 'login':
        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            http_response_code(405);
            exit(json_encode(['error' => 'Method not allowed']));
        }
        // Authentication logic would go here
        $userData = ['id' => 1, 'role' => 'user']; // placeholder
        $token = $manager->createSession($userData);
        setcookie('session', $token, [
            'httponly' => true,
            'secure' => true,
            'samesite' => 'Strict',
            'path' => '/'
        ]);
        echo json_encode(['status' => 'ok']);
        break;
        
    case 'validate':
        $token = $_COOKIE['session'] ?? '';
        $session = $manager->validateSession($token);
        if ($session) {
            echo json_encode(['status' => 'valid', 'user_id' => $session['user_id']]);
        } else {
            http_response_code(401);
            echo json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid session']);
        }
        break;
        
    default:
        http_response_code(400);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'Unknown action']);
}
